candidate_rule: The identical mean and median N=1 output is represented once. For each arm and case, candidates were ranked by SSIM descending, PSNR descending, and MSE ascending; the reported joint rank averages the three per-case metric ranks.

checkpoint_provenance.scope: The inference-policy screen used each arm's terminal checkpoint. The selected policy was subsequently transferred unchanged to that arm's development-selected checkpoint for the held-out 75-case confirmation evaluation.
checkpoint_provenance.checkpoint_hashes: Not available in this compact local snapshot; the canonical source directories above are the source of truth.

fixed.reason: Mean N=3 improved joint rank only marginally (2.9200 to 2.7867), while mean N=5 was worse (3.2400); N=1 was retained for efficiency.

pooled_definition: For each configuration, Pooled is the arithmetic mean of the Fixed, Random, and Weighted joint-rank columns; it is not a separately ranked population.
provenance_note: This file is a compact rank-only snapshot of the previously computed development summary used by the manuscript. The canonical per-case metric directories are recorded above and remain the source of truth; aggregate SSIM, PSNR, and MSE from the screen are not reproduced in this compact snapshot.
